description: 13:00 - 14:45: Balanced cement plug in 9 5/8" CSG m 2569 m pumped 20 m3 wash pill, 2300 LPM/ 60 bar. Mixed and pumped 9,4 m3 of 1,90 SG cement slurry, 600 l/min. Displaced the cement to the rig floor with 2890 l of FW. Zeroed stroke counters. R/d cement hose. Displaced the cement with 39,6 m3 strokes) of SW, 3200 LPM/ 90 bar, using rig pumps.
